key_provisions_or_claims: Value-based design is essential but faces application challenges.
Risks from unintended use of social robots are likely overlooked.
Some risk mitigation strategies are inaccessible to robot designers.
Current system lacks support and incentives for time-consuming ethical design.
Measures can be introduced to support responsible robot development.
annotation.summary_en: Proceedings chapter (abstract page) arguing that value-based design is necessary for ethical social robots but insufficient: unintended-use risks are overlooked, some mitigation strategies are inaccessible to designers, and the system lacks support and incentives for ethical design. It proposes measures for responsible development.
annotation.title_clean: Beyond Value-Based Design: For a More Comprehensive and Supportive System of Ethical Robot Development
annotation.title_en: Beyond Value-Based Design: For a More Comprehensive and Supportive System of Ethical Robot Development
annotation.venue: Social Robots with AI: Prospects, Risks, and Responsible Methods (Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence and Applications 397), IOS Press
